prompts.positive: A cozy and bright living room in a modern country eclectic style. Light blue-grey painted walls, a comfortable blue fabric sofa, and a matching armchair. Light wood plank flooring. Bright natural light streaming through white shutter blinds. Vintage-inspired decor including a retro telephone and a wall sconce. Minimalist framed wall art with text and simple illustrations. Warm and inviting atmosphere.
